name: Alta Pest Control

hero.title: Pest control
hero.lead: Need reliable pest control in Houston, TX? Alta Pest provides year-round pest protection, mosquito treatments, rodent control, and more. Get your free quote today.

summary: Alta Pest Control offers general pest control, mosquito & tick control, and termite control across Houston, Highlands and Liberty.

groups.title: General Pest Control
groups.summary: Our quarterly pest control treatments provide ongoing protection against common household pests.
groups.intro: Our quarterly pest control treatments provide ongoing protection against common household pests, including ants, cockroaches, fleas, spiders, rodents, wasps and more. By treating both the interior and exterior of the home or business, we create a barrier that prevents pests from returning.

groups.title: Mosquito & Tick Control
groups.summary: Mosquitoes and ticks can pose serious health risks, spreading diseases like West Nile virus and Lyme disease.
groups.intro: Mosquitoes and ticks can pose serious health risks, spreading diseases like West Nile virus and Lyme disease. Our seasonal fogging treatments from March to October reduce populations by targeting breeding areas, ensuring your outdoor spaces remain enjoyable and bite-free.

groups.title: Termite Control
groups.summary: For termite control, our certified Sentricon® specialists use bait stations to monitor and eliminate termite colonies before they cause costly damage.
groups.intro: For termite control, our certified Sentricon® specialists use bait stations to monitor and eliminate termite colonies before they cause costly damage.

groups.intro: Reliable pest control services for office buildings and standalone commercial spaces that do not serve food.

groups.title: Rodent Entry Point Sealing
groups.summary: Rodents often access homes through small gaps around the roofline, vents, or foundation.
groups.intro: Rodents often access homes through small gaps around the roofline, vents, or foundation. Our rodent exclusion service identifies and seals these openings.

about.title: About Alta Pest Control
text: Our technicians believe good service starts with good communication. We walk you through what we’re seeing, how the treatment works, and what steps help keep pests from returning.
Many pest issues start with conditions around the home. That’s why we offer services like rodent exclusion, insulation upgrades, and moisture solutions to tackle the source of the problem.
Houston’s climate allows pests to stay active most of the year. Our recurring pest control programs focus on long-term prevention instead of temporary treatments.
